description: Given an x402 endpoint URL, returns the top semantically-similar endpoints (matched on advertised purpose via description embeddings) that currently OUT-SCORE it on the deterministic trust score. Use this to route away from a mediocre/dead/expensive endpoint toward a more reliable, better-settled one serving the SAME function — e.g. before paying, check if a higher-graded equivalent exists. Each alternative carries its trust 'score', 'grade', 'recommendation', cosine 'similarity' (0-1), 'amountUsd' price, 'priceCeiling' (true when amountUsd is an x402 'upto' authorization ceiling, not a fixed per-call price), and a free 'endpointPage' URL. It also carries 'hasDescription': false means the endpoint advertises no description, so its similarity was computed from service name + URL path tokens only, a weaker signal worth more skepticism than a description-based match. Same-host siblings and 'avoid'-flagged endpoints are excluded. An empty 'alternatives' array is a valid answer meaning nothing beats the subject. Similarity is independent of latency/geography. Pay-per-call over x402 (~$0.005); auto-pays if a wallet is configured, otherwise returns the price quote.

minScoreDelta.description: Minimum trust-score advantage an alternative must have over the subject (default 5)

resource.description: Full x402 resource URL to find better alternatives for, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1/thing

name: x402_find_alternatives
title: Find better-scored alternatives to an x402 endpoint (paid)
